about_this_file: A design brief for Leaves, a private journaling app. Use it to create graphics (icons, illustrations, backgrounds, splash screens, store art) that match the app. Every value comes from the app's real design files.

app.name: Leaves
app.one_line: A calm, private journal for your phone. Write about your day, then receive a small drawing and a quotation to keep.
app.platform: Phone-first progressive web app (installs to the home screen on iPhone and Android). Portrait, one column.
app.audience: Thoughtful adults; people who like philosophy, nature and quiet. Made by philosophy students and alumni of SF State and UC Berkeley.
feeling: like a notebook, not a stage
never: feeds, likes, streaks or anything that performs
frames, borders or logos inside illustrations
app.core_imagery: Nature and falling leaves: a single tree that grows one leaf per entry, grass at the bottom of the screen, leaves drifting down slowly, paper-cut edges, soft hand-drawn outlines.

visual_language.style: Soft, cozy storybook-cartoon. Simple rounded shapes, gentle hand-drawn outlines in dark bark brown, flat color with a hint of colored-pencil texture and paper grain. One clear subject, lots of breathing room.
visual_language.texture: barely visible paper grain (about 3% opacity), hand-cut paper edges on pictures
visual_language.shapes: rounded; wobbly paper-cut rectangle for entry pictures; leaf shape is a pointed ellipse with a single center vein
visual_language.small_details: tiny ditsy floral prints like old cotton fabric on small details; an occasional small woodland creature, simply drawn; fireflies, petals, butterflies as light accents
rules_for_pictures: nature and objects only; no people's faces (a tiny figure seen from far behind is fine)
no text, letters, logos, borders or frames in the image
square composition, subject placed left, center or right with space around it
calm limited palette; touches of honey yellow and rosehip pink only as accents
must read clearly at 96 px thumbnail size as well as large

color.note: Two themes: Daylight (default, 'leaf paper') and Lamplight (night, 'night fern'). Decoration colors are never used for text.

writing_and_titles.use: entry text, titles, quotations (quotations in italic)

layout_and_shape.icons: rounded line icons, 2 px stroke, round caps and joins, 24 px grid, always paired with a text label
layout_and_shape.motion: slow and soft: fades about 300 ms; leaves fall for about 4 seconds; a gentle 4 second 'breathing' loader; all motion reduces to short fades when Reduce motion is on

screens.name: Welcome
screens.description: One sentence, a Begin button, a few leaves drifting behind, grass along the bottom edge.

screens.name: Write
screens.description: Today's date, a quiet italic quotation, photos with captions beneath them like a blog, a large serif writing area, a bottom bar (Add place, Keep from AI, Finish) above a strip of grass.

screens.name: Entry
screens.description: Hand-drawn picture on a paper-cut edge at the top, serif title, date stamp, photos with italic captions, the writer's text, then the quotation and a short reflection.

screens.name: Entries
screens.description: A bare tree that grows one leaf per entry (each leaf colored by mood), then a vine timeline of entries with small picture thumbnails.

screens.name: Voices
screens.description: A library of about 285 quotations from about 137 voices across history, grouped by tradition.

screens.name: Settings, Recently deleted, About
screens.description: Plain, calm lists on leaf paper.

illustration_system.description: Every entry gets one small picture, chosen as a visual metaphor for what the entry is really about. The picture is composed from the vocabulary below: one subject, how many there are and how they relate, a setting, weather, light and up to three small accents.
examples_of_meaning: someone who made the day better: two birds together on a branch
a message across a distance: two lanterns reaching toward each other
a decision: a path that forks
holding a lot at once: a cairn of balanced stones
a beginning: a seedling in the first light
grief: a lone tree in mist

arrangements.meaning: alone is one; together, reaching and apart are two; gathered is three

light.meaning: glow is warmth, rays is hope breaking through, dim is heaviness

classic_motifs: a small boat on still water

assets_wanted.name: App icon
assets_wanted.notes: a single leaf or a small tree on leaf-green paper; must also work as a maskable icon with a safe zone of about 80% in the center; no text

assets_wanted.name: Entry pictures
assets_wanted.notes: square, paper-cut edge, soft outlines; produce a set per subject in the vocabulary, in daylight and night variants

assets_wanted.name: Falling-leaf set
assets_wanted.notes: 6 to 10 leaf variations (maple, birch, oak, ginkgo, simple) in the mood palette, transparent background, about 96 px, for the drifting-leaves animation

assets_wanted.name: Tree growth stages
assets_wanted.notes: a bare tree that gains leaves; 8 stages from sapling to full autumn canopy, transparent background

assets_wanted.name: Grass strip
assets_wanted.notes: a seamless horizontal tuft pattern about 28 px tall with tiny honey and rosehip flower dots; daylight and night versions

assets_wanted.name: Welcome and splash backgrounds
assets_wanted.notes: very quiet; leaf-paper color, faint grain, a few drifting leaves; iPhone launch screens in light and dark

assets_wanted.name: Store and share art
assets_wanted.notes: shareable card: picture, title, a line of text, an italic quotation; same type and colors as the app

prompt_for_picture_generation.template: A small square illustration in a soft, cozy storybook-cartoon style. Simple rounded shapes, gentle hand-drawn outlines in dark bark brown, flat color with a hint of colored-pencil texture and paper grain. A calm, limited palette: leaf green, moss, fern, pale sage paper, misty blue sky, with small touches of honey yellow and rosehip pink. Nature at the center, uncluttered, with plenty of breathing room and one clear subject. Tiny ditsy floral prints, like old cotton fabric, may appear on small details. An occasional small woodland creature, simply drawn, is welcome. No text, letters, logos, borders, or frames. No photorealism and no people's faces; a tiny figure seen from far behind is fine. Feeling: quiet and tender, touched by {one of the moods}. Scene: {ONE SENTENCE DESCRIBING NATURE AND OBJECTS ONLY}. Season: {spring|summer|autumn|winter}. Time of day: {dawn|morning|afternoon|evening|night}.
tips: Ask for a transparent background or flat pale sage paper color.
Ask for 'no text, no people's faces'.
Generate several and keep the quietest.

quotation_style.display: serif italic, left aligned, quotation marks for exact quotes; paraphrases appear without quotation marks and are credited 'after Author'
quotation_style.credit: author in bold UI sans, source in regular weight, muted color
traditions_in_the_library: Persia, the Arab world and Islam
Virtue, care and the good life
